scope: Paris–Osaka plus transitions, including 23 BPO transition cases; excludes standalone BPO fork suites
method: Suite wall-clock span: max(test end) minus min(test start). Includes fixture extraction and simulator/client startup; excludes Docker image builds.
comparison: Same host, fixture release, case count, worker count, check-time limit, and client image within each pair. Daily runs, not repeated controlled benchmarks.
provenance: Saved analysis of public Hive dashboard runs, captured 2026-07-19. Not freshly rerun.
